learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will expand their vocabulary by learning words with similar meanings (synonyms) and opposite meanings (antonyms).]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Why say 'good' all the time when you can say 'fantastic', 'excellent', or 'superb'? Words have twins that mean almost the same thing, and rivals that mean the exact opposite! Let's build a powerful vocabulary.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Synonyms are words that have the exact same, or very similar, meanings. Using synonyms makes your writing much more interesting to read because you don't repeat the same words over and over.
Antonyms are words that have opposite meanings. They are completely different from each other, like day and night!
Sometimes, you don't need a whole new word to make an antonym. You can just add a few letters to the beginning of a word (a prefix) to flip its meaning to the opposite!

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which word is a synonym for 'Quick'?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write two synonyms for the word 'Small'.
subjective_practice.hint: Think of words that mean very little in size. (Starts with 't' and 'm')

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Use a prefix to make the antonym of 'Kind'.
subjective_practice.hint: Add 'un-' to the beginning of the word.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Rewrite this sentence using an antonym for the bold word: 'The box was very **heavy**.'
subjective_practice.hint: What is the opposite of heavy? (Rhymes with 'bright')

activity_or_assignment.title: 🎭 The Opposite Game
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Say a word out loud (like 'Up', 'Laugh', 'Hard', 'Dirty') and point to someone in your family. They have 3 seconds to shout the correct Antonym! If they get it right, it is their turn to pick a word.

chapter_summary: ⭐ Synonyms are words that mean the same thing (Big / Huge).
⭐ Antonyms are words that mean the opposite of each other (Day / Night).
⭐ Adding prefixes like un-, dis-, or in- can turn a word into its antonym (agree -> disagree).
